parts.content: I am flying to Tashkent on Friday. What will the weather be like, and is it <warmer> than Samarkand & Bukhara?

gen_ai.system_instructions.content: You are a travel assistant. Answer in one short paragraph, name the source of every figure you give, and call a tool rather than guess whenever the question depends on current conditions.

gen_ai.tool.definitions.description: Current conditions and a three day forecast for a city.
gen_ai.tool.definitions.name: get_weather

gen_ai.tool.definitions.description: Direct flights between two airports on a date, cheapest first.
gen_ai.tool.definitions.name: find_flights
